title: glyce maritima
intro: Glyce maritima, commonly known as sea buckthorn, is a shrub-like plant that is native to Europe and Asia. It is rich in health benefits, including its ability to improve cardiovascular health, boost the immune system, and support digestive health. The therapeutic actions of glyce maritima include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe wounds, reduce inflammation, and fight off infections. The bioactive constituents of glyce maritima include flavonoids, carotenoids, and vitamins, particularly vitamin C and vitamin E, which are responsible for its numerous health benefits.
